interface.title: Volumizer Gallery
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis and triage of results: detect occluded volumes in structures, then browse, filter, compare and inspect them in 3D
interface.what_it_is_for: Upload PDB/CIF protein structures to have volumizer detect and classify their cavities, pockets and pores, then filter, sort and compare the indexed results across structures and inspect each annotated volume in a Mol* 3D viewer.

data.note: The gallery started with one pre-indexed hit, 4jpn (run 'out'). I uploaded pore.pdb (2.0 Å, asymmetric), cavity.pdb twice (3.0 Å biological found no volumes; 1.5 Å auto found 1 cavity and 12 pockets, indexed as 'cavity-2') and pocket.pdb (3.0 Å biological, 1 pocket of 594). That made 5 results. Results depend on resolution: in the replay, pore.pdb at 3.0 Å / biological gave 0 pores and 1 pocket (1,404), where this run's 2.0 Å / asymmetric gave 1 pore (1,904) and 1 pocket (48). Thumbnails stay as blank X/Y/Z placeholders on every card, because Playwright is not installed. Only single PDB uploads through the browser were used; according to the reviewer, the README's main route into the gallery is indexing a run.summary.json from a CLI or cluster run, which happens outside the browser UI and was not exercised here.

tree.general: Find, measure and compare enclosed empty spaces in 3D molecular structures to pick candidates for binding or transport studies
tree.specific: Detect cavities, pockets and pores in protein structures with volumizer, index them in the gallery, and triage them with filters, sorting and the Mol* viewer

screens_never_reached: Rendered thumbnail images on the gallery cards: every card shows blank X/Y/Z placeholders because Playwright Chromium is not installed (the status card said 'Thumbnail ready' but no image appeared)
A second results page: with 5 hits and the smallest page size of 12, Previous/Next stayed disabled
A user-saved filter or display preset in the dropdown: Save opens a browser name prompt that was auto-accepted with no name, so nothing was saved
not_done: Saving a named filter preset or display preset: the Save prompt can't be typed into from this browser, so it was accepted empty and nothing was stored. Del was not tried, to avoid removing the built-in presets
Clicking a row in the per-volume table did nothing in the viewer (no highlight or focus); I found no way to jump from a table row to its volume in 3D
Mol* Measurements (distance/angle between picked atoms), Export Models/Animation/Geometry, Toggle Full Screen and the Settings panel were seen but not used, to stay within the action budget

No 'cluster' mode, batch upload of several files, or CIF upload was tried; only single PDB uploads. Indexing a run.summary.json from a CLI or cluster run (the README's main route, per the reviewer) is outside the browser and was not done

Filtering by shape (min circularity/uniformity, min/max diameter) and by host-protein properties (chains, residues, α/β/coil) as filters of their own: the fields exist in the sidebar but were not used, apart from the Pockets preset filling Max unique chains and Max coil
Hiding or inspecting one ranked pocket at a time: Mol* groups all pockets in one 'Pockets' component, and pore.pdb and 4jpn showed only a 'Pocket Mouths' component, so I could not isolate one pocket

Filter Reset bug (sticky preset): once a filter preset is loaded, Reset does not clear its field values, and choosing 'None' in the preset dropdown then pressing Reset sends the dropdown back to 'Pockets' (screens/023.webp). The fields stay until cleared by hand
Display-property choices did not carry over between browser tabs; each tab started from Default
Replay side notes: each Annotation JSON / Annotated CIF click also opened an empty new tab, and Illumination path tracing is very slow in a headless browser
